categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Matches 'Wallet' label and modifies wallet transaction resubmission and rebroadcast logic.
categories.rationale: Fixes a wallet privacy leak where periodic rebroadcasts unconditionally relay unconfirmed transactions even when already present in the mempool, linking node identity to transaction ownership (#36403). Delay is not catastrophic enough for P1 given the long-standing nature of the behavior, but it provides durable privacy improvements for wallet users.
